description: Find market and macro data series on Global Macro Expert by keyword (e.g. "brent", "euribor", "german power", "copper", "gold positioning", "s&p 500 asset managers", "india market capitalization", "systemic stress"). Returns ids with the latest value, date, unit and source (equities and stress series also carry their license and attribution line). Cite results exactly as given in each result's "cite" field ("Source: Global Macro Expert (globalmacro.expert), Siller Advisory; original source: [original source, license]") plus the original source's own required attribution.
name: search_series
title: Search series
